# 78 UI Kit

> A theme-forward, no-build UI kit — plain HTML / CSS / JS you drop in. One stylesheet, one script, and
> every color resolves at runtime from CSS custom properties, so re-theming is an override block rather
> than a rebuild. Built for dashboards: KPI cards, tables, no-library data-viz primitives, and theme
> adapters that recolor Tabulator, FullCalendar and Chart.js along with everything else — including on a
> live theme switch. MIT.

Two things shape every decision in the kit:

- **Theme-forward.** A theme is *only* color. Color tokens live in `:root[data-theme="dark"]` /
  `["light"]`; non-color tokens (radius, type, spacing, layout sizes) live in a plain `:root`. Nothing
  hardcodes a color, so overriding the tokens re-themes the whole kit.
- **Built for dashboards.** Stat/KPI cards, a table style, sparkline / progress / bar / donut / gauge /
  trend primitives, an app shell, and adapters so third-party tables and charts follow the theme too.

No framework. No build step. No dependencies. Version 0.x — the public API may still change before 1.0.

## Install

```html
<head>
  <!-- 1. pre-paint theme — FIRST, before any stylesheet (no flash of the wrong theme) -->
  <script>
  (function(){var p=localStorage.getItem('_78-theme')||'system';
  var t=p==='system'?(matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches?'light':'dark'):p;
  var r=document.documentElement;r.dataset.theme=t;r.dataset.themePref=p;})();
  </script>

  <!-- 2. the kit -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/1978io/78UIKit@v0.3.0/css/kit.css">
  <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/1978io/78UIKit@v0.3.0/js/_78.js"></script>

  <!-- 3. your theme overrides — AFTER the kit -->
  <style>:root[data-theme="dark"]{--accent:#7c5cff}</style>
</head>
```

`@v0.3.0` pins a release; `@main` tracks the latest. `kit.min.css` / `_78.min.js` are also served. Or
download the repo and serve the files yourself. Library adapters are opt-in and live under
`/css/adapters/` and `/js/adapters/` — they are never part of `kit.css`.

## Naming

- **CSS classes** are prefixed `_78-` — `._78-btn`, `._78-stat-card`, `._78-nav-item`.
- **Modifiers** are suffixes on the block class — `._78-btn-primary`, `._78-table-compact` — and shared
  state classes are their own prefixed class alongside it: `._78-active`, `._78-selected`, `._78-up`,
  `._78-down`, `._78-invert`, `._78-high` / `._78-mid` / `._78-low`, `._78-danger`.
- **JS** is one global, `_78`, with no dependencies: `_78.theme`, `_78.tone`, `_78.util`, `_78.shell`, `_78.modal`, `_78.notify`,
  `_78.tabs`, `_78.seg`, `_78.viz`, `_78.adapters.chartjs`, `_78.gen`.
- **Events** are namespaced `_78:` and fire on `document` (except `_78:tabchange`, which bubbles from the
  tab list, and `_78:segchange`, which bubbles from the segmented control): `_78:themechange`,
  `_78:railchange`, `_78:drawerchange`, `_78:tabchange`, `_78:segchange`, `_78:genchange`.

## Tokens

Token *names* are the contract; the shipped values are a neutral default palette meant to be overridden.

- **Core color:** `--bg` `--bg2` `--bg3` `--border` `--text` `--dim` `--accent`
- **Accent derived:** `--accent-hover` `--accent-text` `--accent-lo` `--accent-lo-hover` `--accent-glow`
- **Semantic:** `--success` `--warn` `--danger` `--info`, each with a `-lo` tint
- **Categories:** `--cat-1` … `--cat-6`, each with a `-lo` tint — label colors that are not states
- **Charts:** `--series-2` — the second chart series, a gray that recedes behind `--accent`
- **Surface details:** `--row-hover` `--row-border` `--row-selected` `--ring` `--overlay` `--shadow`
  `--shadow-lg`
- **Non-color (shared `:root`):** `--radius-sm` `--radius` `--radius-lg` `--radius-pill` · `--font`
  `--font-mono` · `--fs-xs`…`--fs-xl` `--lh` · `--space-1`…`--space-6` · `--control-h` `--control-h-sm`
  `--icon-btn-size` `--ring-w` · `--sidebar-w` `--rail-w` `--header-h` `--content-max` · `--transition`
  `--transition-slow`

The `--space-*` tokens are also the escape hatch above the utility scale: there is no margin utility over
16px and there are no padding utilities, by design — use the token directly instead.

## Tones

One vocabulary for every component that takes a tone, and it is the token names: `accent` `success`
`warn` `danger` `info` `dim`. Aliases, permanent and identical: `green` = success, `red` = danger, `amber` /
`yellow` = warn. Write the canonical name.

- Badge `._78-badge-{tone}` · tag `._78-tag-{tone}` · text `._78-text-{tone}` or `._78-{tone}` (also on
  `._78-stat-card__num`) · alert `._78-alert-{tone}` · data-viz `._78-tone-{tone}` / `data-tone` · modal
  `tone:` · toast `type:` (`danger` = the toast's `error`). All six on each.
- `_78.tone('red')` → `'danger'`; `_78.tone.names` lists the six.
- **Categories** (labels that are not states, like a source or a team): `cat-1` … `cat-6` on badge, tag,
  text and viz tone — `._78-badge-cat-3`. Hues sit clear of success / warn / danger; use them in order.

## Components

- **App shell** — `._78-topbar` + `._78-sidebar` that collapses to an icon rail and becomes a mobile
  drawer, plus `._78-app-main`; driven by `_78.shell`. Flat nav items only, no nested menus. The open
  drawer keeps keyboard focus inside it and makes the page behind `inert`.
- **Buttons** — `._78-btn` (`-primary` / `-ghost` / `-danger` / `-sm` / `-full`), `._78-icon-btn`,
  `._78-btn-group`.
- **Cards** — `._78-card` and the KPI `._78-stat-card` (label / number / delta / sparkline), laid out by
  `._78-kpi-grid` / `._78-card-grid`. Stacked cards space themselves; in a grid they line up at the top.
- **Forms** — `._78-field` with `._78-input` / `._78-select` / `._78-textarea` / `._78-check` and one
  consistent focus ring.
- **Toggle switch** — `._78-switch` (+ `-sm`, `._78-switch-row`), a real `<input type="checkbox">`
  restyled as a track and thumb, so keyboard, `:disabled` and label association are native. Stacked
  `._78-switch-row`s space themselves.
- **Segmented control** — `._78-seg` / `._78-seg-btn` (+ `-sm` / `-full` / `-accent`), one-of-N, mounted
  by `_78.seg` as a `radiogroup` with roving tabindex; fires `_78:segchange`.
- **Disclosure** — `._78-details` (+ `-plain` / `-fill` / `-sm`), a styled `<details>` / `<summary>` with
  a rotating chevron marker. CSS only.
- **Figure row** — `._78-figure-row` / `._78-figure`, N related numbers side by side, each with a label
  and a `._78-tone-*` colored left edge.
- **Badges & pills** — `._78-badge` and `._78-tag` (any tone), `._78-score-pill`, `._78-eyebrow`.
- **Table** — `._78-table` (`-compact` / `-striped` / `-sticky`) in a `._78-table-wrap` scroller. For a
  real data grid, use Tabulator plus its adapter.
- **Tabs** — `._78-tabs` (+ `._78-tabs-segmented`), auto-mounted by `_78.tabs` with full ARIA and arrow
  keys.
- **Dropdown menu** — `._78-menu-wrap` > trigger + `._78-menu`, auto-wired with roving focus and the
  `menu` / `menuitem` roles.
- **Modal** — native `<dialog>` via `_78.modal.open()` / `.confirm()` / `.alert()`, promise-returning.
  `confirm()` and `alert()` resolve `true` for their button and `false` for any dismissal.
- **Toast** — `_78.notify()` and `.success` / `.error` (or `.danger`) / `.warn` / `.info`; auto-dismissing, never
  blocking.
- **Inline alert** — `._78-alert` (+ any tone) and
  `._78-empty`, for anything tied to a region of the page.
- **Data-viz, no library** — `._78-sparkline`, `._78-progress`, `._78-bar-row`, `._78-split-bar` (a whole
  divided into named, proportional segments), `._78-donut` / `._78-gauge`, `._78-trend`, driven by
  `_78.viz` and toned with one class.
- **Theme toggle** — any `._78-theme-toggle` element is wired on load and cycles Dark → Light → System.
- **Utilities** — a small set: `._78-text-dim`, `._78-flex`, `._78-gap-12`, `._78-mt-16`, `._78-truncate`,
  `._78-nums`, `._78-sr-only`, `._78-list-plain`, and friends. Plain lists inside an alert body, card,
  modal body or disclosure keep their indent and markers. Text color takes any tone, in two
  interchangeable spellings: `._78-text-danger` / `._78-danger`.

## Helpers — `_78.util`

- `_78.util.sortAlpha(a, b)` — a human-sort comparator (case-insensitive, locale-aware, "Item 2" before
  "Item 10", blanks last) for `array.sort()` or a Tabulator `sorter`.
- `_78.util.duration(ms, { long, parts })` — "45 sec", "2 hrs 5 min", "3 days"; `long: true` spells
  units out, `parts` caps how many (default 2). Never "0 min".

## Library adapters (opt-in)

- **Tabulator 6.x** (verified against 6.5.2) — `css/adapters/tabulator.css`, loaded after Tabulator's own
  stylesheet. Covers responsive-collapse mode too (the fold-out panel wraps long values; the +/- toggle is
  accent-colored).
- **FullCalendar 7.x core** (verified against 7.0.2) — `css/adapters/fullcalendar.css`, loaded after
  FullCalendar's CSS.
- **Chart.js 4.x** (verified against 4.5.1) — `js/adapters/chartjs.js`, loaded after Chart.js and after
  `_78.js`. Canvas cannot read CSS variables, so it pushes tokens into `Chart.defaults` and calls
  `update()` on every live chart when the theme switches (datasets, legend, tooltip and scales). Don't set
  those colors per chart. Series colors: `--accent`, `--series-2`, then
  `--cat-1` … `--cat-6`.

The version beside each library is the one its adapter was checked against; re-check after a major upgrade.

Nothing is vendored — bring your own copy of each library at your own version.

## Theme generator

`js/generator.js` (`_78.gen`) derives the whole token set for light *and* dark from one accent color, in
OKLCH, with live WCAG AA checks, an apply-to-the-page mode and a shareable `?theme=` URL. Opt-in, not part
of `_78.js`.
